_comment: Reviewed row by row against the PII-TRACE paper's Table 6 (arXiv 2609.22200) and the PII-Tracer model card, revision d25c16f2. A row lists only canonical labels the native label's documented coverage names; a class the model cannot emit earns no credit. Byte leak/false-positive scoring is class-agnostic, so this table drives the typed metrics, the common-intersection view and v3 gold-gap credit only. person: full name, name part, social handle/username. address: postal address and precise location (country/region/state kept for parity with the OPF row, which shares this taxonomy). url: profile URL or IP address (IP has no main-corpus label). date: date of birth or identifying date (only DATEOFBIRTH is annotated). account_number: national ID, SSN, IBAN, card, sort code, id number; only the four explicitly named types with a main-corpus label are credited, so passport, driver licence, ID card, tax and plate numbers earn nothing. secret: password/API key/CVV/PIN, scored as custom:secret exactly as OPF's is (typed credit only under v1). other_pii is a residual bucket with no stated class, so it maps to nothing.
